supersession_reason: The V1 parser accepted caller-supplied counts and work without binding deck, FRD and case identities; raw evidence remains preserved.
method: The same four-edge coupled external decks add *EL PRINT ELSE for Plate and Web. Modified-deck FRD action work matches the prior loaded-work values exactly at reported precision. The native result uses the block-diagonal shell/beam stiffness and the full constrained solution; each split sums to half its applied work within 1e-8 relative.
decision: The torque-case domain energy allocations differ substantially: the external welded S4 model stores about 18.9% in the plate, compared with about 0.62% for native L1 A and 1.51% for B. This does not isolate interface transfer because the torque work conjugates, S4 web, B3 section and connection law differ. Do not select A/B or alter the law from this split alone. The remaining discriminator is a reviewed supported virtual side-work map or equivalent physically matched operator partition.
limitations: Element ELSE is an internal-energy partition, not the interface force or moment conjugate to a trial trace.
The S4 wall and B3 section have different isolated torque work; the S4 shared seam is not the native weak L1 law.
One mesh level does not establish convergence, interface stability, or the required physical transfer accuracy.
CalculiX DAT/FRD output rounding sets a small nonzero energy-work closure error.
